x: Our retiring President, T.C. Jones, then gave an account of Les Cohen's successes in active athletics and his rise to the top of the administrative ladder.
The President T.C. Jones, opened the meeting, and the Secretary in presenting his report, spoke of the respect with which the 'Belgrave' are viewed by other clubs and officials in the athletic world.
Ten members were elected to serve on the Committee as follows:- F.R.Webb, H.Parker, T.F.Morell, F.H.Elson, H.W.Shields, L.J.Cohen, C.T.Carter, E.A.Duffett, R.J.Savage and T.C.Jones."
